**Make .bgen files**
```{bash}
#make .bgen
plink2 --pfile ~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final --export bgen-1.2 --out ~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final 

#make .bgen.bgi
~/multi_susie/bgen/build/apps/bgenix -g ~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final.bgen -index 
```

**Make zfiles**
```{bash}
#make .z file
awk 'NR==1 {print "rsid chromosome position allele1 allele2"} NR>1 {gsub(/^chr/, "", $1); if($1=="23") $1="X"; print $3, $1, $2, $5, $4}' ~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final.pvar > ~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final.z

tail ~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final.z

#read the windows file (skip header)
tail -n +2 ~/sushie/cis_windows.txt | while IFS=$'\t' read -r olinkid chr left right; do
    echo "Creating z file for $olinkid on $chr:$left-$right"
    
    #extract variants in this region from your .z file
    awk -v chr="$chr" -v start="$left" -v end="$right" \
        'NR==1 {print} NR>1 && $2==chr && $3>=start && $3<=end' \
        ~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final.z > \
        ~/multi_susie/z_files/ancestry_specific_folder/${olinkid}.z
done
```

**Make master files**
```{bash}
#create the master file with header
echo "z;bgen;bgi;bcor;n_samples" > ~/multi_susie/master_files/ancestry_specific_master.txt

#read the windows file (skip header) and add each protein as a line
tail -n +2 ~/sushie/cis_windows.txt | while IFS=$'\t' read -r olinkid chr left right; do
    
    #add line for protein
    echo "~/multi_susie/z_files/ancestry_specific_folder/${olinkid}.z;~/ancestry_specific_folder/ancestry_final.bgen.bgi;~/multi_susie/ld_files/ancestry_specific_folder/${olinkid}.bcor;366" >> ~/multi_susie/master_files/ancestry_specific_master.txt
done

echo "Done creating master file"
echo "Total proteins: $(( $(wc -l < ~/multi_susie/master_files/ancestry_specific_master.txt) - 1 ))"
```

**Make .bcor files**
```{bash}
~/multi_susie/ldstore_v2.0_x86_64/ldstore_v2.0_x86_64 --in-files ~/multi_susie/master_files/ancestry_specific_master.txt --write-bcor --read-only-bgen --n-threads 10
```

**Run MultiSuSiE Fine-mapping**
```{python}
def build_rlist(protein_id, ldstore_path="~/multi_susie/ldstore_v2.0_x86_64/ldstore_v2.0_x86_64"):
    R_list = []

    work_dir = f'~/multi_susie/tmp/{protein_id}'
    os.makedirs(work_dir, exist_ok=True)
    original_dir = os.getcwd()
    os.chdir(work_dir)

    for ancestry in ancestries:
        bcor_file = f'~/multi_susie/ld_files/{ancestry}/{protein_id}.bcor'
        tmp_ld_file = f'{work_dir}/{protein_id}_{ancestry}.ld'
        try:
            cmd = f"{ldstore_path} --bcor-to-text --bcor-file {bcor_file} --ld-file {tmp_ld_file} > /dev/null 2>&1"

            #retry ldstore up to 3 times with LD matrix validation
            max_attempts = 3
            ld_matrix = None
            for attempt in range(max_attempts):
                os.system(cmd)
                if not os.path.exists(tmp_ld_file) or os.path.getsize(tmp_ld_file) == 0:
                    print(f"Retry {attempt + 1}/{max_attempts} — empty file for {protein_id} {ancestry}")
                    continue
                try:
                    ld_matrix = np.loadtxt(tmp_ld_file)
                    if ld_matrix.ndim != 2 or ld_matrix.shape[0] != ld_matrix.shape[1]:
                        raise ValueError(f"LD matrix not square: {ld_matrix.shape}")
                    break  # success
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Retry {attempt + 1}/{max_attempts} — malformed file for {protein_id} {ancestry}: {e}")
                    ld_matrix = None
                    if os.path.exists(tmp_ld_file):
                        os.remove(tmp_ld_file)

            if ld_matrix is None:
                print(f"Error: ldstore failed after {max_attempts} attempts for {protein_id} {ancestry}")
                os.chdir(original_dir)
                return None

            print(f"loaded LD matrix for {protein_id} {ancestry}")
            R_list.append(ld_matrix)

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error processing r_list {protein_id} {ancestry}: {e}")
            os.chdir(original_dir)
            return None
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(tmp_ld_file):
                os.remove(tmp_ld_file)

    os.chdir(original_dir)
    try:
        os.rmdir(work_dir)
    except:
        pass

    return R_list

#build beta and se lists
def build_b_and_se_list(protein_id, chrom):
    b_list = []
    se_list = []
    nominal_data = []
    for ancestry in ancestries:
        try:
            file_path = f"~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensorqtl/nominal/nominalchr{chrom}cis_qtls.gz"
            nominal_content = pd.read_csv(file_path, sep='\t', compression='gzip')
            nominal_oid = nominal_content[nominal_content['phenotype_id'] == protein_id]
            nominal_data.append(nominal_oid)
            b_list.append(nominal_oid['slope'].tolist())
            se_list.append(nominal_oid['slope_se'].tolist())
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error processing b_list or se_list {protein_id} {ancestry}: {e}")
            return None
    return b_list, se_list, nominal_data

#build var y list
def build_varY_list(protein_id):
    varY_list = []
    for ancestry in ancestries:
        try:
            file_path = f"~/ancestry_specific_folder/tensor_lm_table.bed"
            lm_table = pd.read_csv(file_path, sep='\t')
            lm_table_oid = lm_table[lm_table['gene_id'] == protein_id]
            if len(lm_table_oid) > 1:
                print(f"Warning: multiple rows found for {protein_id} in {ancestry}, using first")
            protein_levels = lm_table_oid.filter(regex='^NWD').iloc[0].tolist()
            protein_variance = np.var(protein_levels, ddof=1)
            varY_list.append(float(protein_variance))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error processing varY_list {protein_id} {ancestry}: {e}")
            return None
    return varY_list

#subset to common snps and regularize ld
def subset_to_common_snps(R_list, b_list, se_list, nominal_data):

    #handle LD/nominal size mismatches
    for i, R in enumerate(R_list):
        n_snps_ld = R.shape[0]
        n_snps_nominal = len(nominal_data[i])
        if n_snps_ld != n_snps_nominal:
            print(f"Warning: {ancestries[i]} - LD matrix has {n_snps_ld} SNPs but nominal data has {n_snps_nominal} SNPs")
            min_snps = min(n_snps_ld, n_snps_nominal)
            R_list[i] = R[:min_snps, :min_snps]
            b_list[i] = b_list[i][:min_snps]
            se_list[i] = se_list[i][:min_snps]
            nominal_data[i] = nominal_data[i].iloc[:min_snps].reset_index(drop=True)

    #find common SNPs across all ancestries
    snp_sets = [nominal['variant_id'].tolist() for nominal in nominal_data]
    common_snps = set(snp_sets[0])
    for snp_set in snp_sets[1:]:
        common_snps = common_snps.intersection(set(snp_set))
    common_snps = list(common_snps)
    print(f"Common SNPs across all ancestries: {len(common_snps)}")

    #subset to common SNPs and regularize LD
    R_list_subset = []
    b_list_subset = []
    se_list_subset = []
    index_mapping = []

    for i in range(len(ancestries)):

        #find indices of common SNPs in this ancestry
        snp_indices = []
        for snp in common_snps:
            try:
                idx = snp_sets[i].index(snp)
                snp_indices.append(idx)
            except ValueError:
                print(f"Warning: SNP {snp} not found in {ancestries[i]}")
        snp_indices.sort()

        #subset LD matrix and data
        R_subset = R_list[i][np.ix_(snp_indices, snp_indices)]

        #convert to numpy arrays
        b_subset = np.array([b_list[i][idx] for idx in snp_indices], dtype=np.float32)
        se_subset = np.array([se_list[i][idx] for idx in snp_indices], dtype=np.float32)

        #index mapping for reference
        ancestry_mapping = []
        for post_idx, pre_idx in enumerate(snp_indices):
            ancestry_mapping.append({
                'SNP': snp_sets[i][pre_idx],
                'pre_filter_index': pre_idx,
                'post_filter_index': post_idx,
                'ancestry': ancestries[i]
            })
        index_mapping.append(ancestry_mapping)

        R_list_subset.append(R_subset)
        b_list_subset.append(b_subset)
        se_list_subset.append(se_subset)

    #order common SNPs by position in first ancestry
    first_ancestry_indices = []
    for snp in common_snps:
        idx = snp_sets[0].index(snp)
        first_ancestry_indices.append((idx, snp))
    first_ancestry_indices.sort()
    ordered_common_snps = [snp for idx, snp in first_ancestry_indices]

    return R_list_subset, b_list_subset, se_list_subset, ordered_common_snps, index_mapping

#function
R_list = build_rlist(protein_id)
if R_list is None:
    print(f"NO_CREDIBLE_SETS: Failed to build LD list for {protein_id}")
    sys.exit(0)

result = build_b_and_se_list(protein_id, chrom)
if result is None:
    print(f"NO_CREDIBLE_SETS: Failed to build b/se list for {protein_id}")
    sys.exit(0)
b_list, se_list, nominal_data = result

varY_list = build_varY_list(protein_id)
if varY_list is None:
    print(f"NO_CREDIBLE_SETS: Failed to build varY list for {protein_id}")
    sys.exit(0)

R_list, b_list, se_list, common_snp_ids, index_mapping = subset_to_common_snps(
    R_list, b_list, se_list, nominal_data
)

#run multisusie
try:
    ss_fit = MultiSuSiE.multisusie_rss(
        b_list = b_list,
        s_list = se_list,
        R_list = R_list,
        varY_list = varY_list,
        rho = np.array([[1.0,  0.75, 0.75, 0.75],
                        [0.75, 1.0,  0.75, 0.75],
                        [0.75, 0.75, 1.0,  0.75],
                        [0.75, 0.75, 0.75, 1.0]]),
        population_sizes = [1270, 675, 366, 642],
        L = 10,
        scaled_prior_variance = 0.2,
        prior_weights = None,
        standardize = False,
        pop_spec_standardization = True,
        estimate_residual_variance = True,
        estimate_prior_variance = True,
        estimate_prior_method = 'early_EM',
        pop_spec_effect_priors = True,
        iter_before_zeroing_effects = 5,
        prior_tol = 1e-9,
        max_iter = 100,
        tol = 0.001,
        verbose = False,
        coverage = 0.95,
        min_abs_corr = 0.5,
        float_type = np.float32,
        low_memory_mode = True,
        recover_R = False,
        single_population_mac_thresh = 0,
        mac_list = None,
        multi_population_maf_thresh = 0,
        maf_list = None,
        variant_ids = None
    )
except Exception as e:
    print(f"NO_CREDIBLE_SETS: MultiSuSiE failed for {protein_id}: {e}")
    sys.exit(0)

#extract credible sets
cs_results = []

if hasattr(ss_fit, 'sets') and ss_fit.sets[0]:
    credible_sets  = ss_fit.sets[0]
    purity         = ss_fit.sets[1]
    coverage       = ss_fit.sets[2]
    passed_filter  = ss_fit.sets[3]

    has_valid_cs = False
    for cs_idx, credible_set in enumerate(credible_sets):
        if passed_filter[cs_idx] and len(credible_set) > 0:
            has_valid_cs = True
            for variant_idx in credible_set:
                actual_snp_id = (common_snp_ids[variant_idx]
                                 if variant_idx < len(common_snp_ids)
                                 else f"variant_{variant_idx}")
                cs_results.append({
                    'OlinkID':     protein_id,
                    'SNP':         actual_snp_id,
                    'Index':       variant_idx,
                    'CredibleSet': cs_idx + 1,
                    'PIP':         ss_fit.pip[variant_idx],
                    'Purity':      purity[cs_idx],
                    'Coverage':    coverage[cs_idx]
                })

    if has_valid_cs:
        cs_results_df = pd.DataFrame(cs_results)
        cs_results_df.to_csv(
            f'~/multi_susie/output/{protein_id}_credible_sets.tsv',
            sep="\t", index=False
        )
        print(f"SUCCESS: Found {len(set([r['CredibleSet'] for r in cs_results]))} credible sets for {protein_id}")
    else:
        print(f"NO_CREDIBLE_SETS: No valid credible sets found for {protein_id}")
else:
    print(f"NO_CREDIBLE_SETS: Multi-SuSiE did not identify any credible sets for {protein_id}")
```

**Combine files**
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

#root directory where condensed finemap files are located
root_dir <- "~/multi_susie/finemap_output"

# Find all condensed finemap files
condensed_files <- list.files(path = root_dir, pattern = "*_credible_sets.tsv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
cat("Found", length(condensed_files), "condensed finemap files\n")

#process all files and combine using rbind
all_data <- list()
for (i in 1:length(condensed_files)) {
  file <- condensed_files[i]
  tryCatch({
    # Read the file (only keeping the needed columns)
    data <- read.table(file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    #keep only the columns we want
    if (all(c("OlinkID", "SNP", "Index", "CredibleSet", "PIP", "Purity", "Coverage") %in% colnames(data))) {
      data <- data[, c("OlinkID", "SNP", "CredibleSet", "PIP")]
      all_data[[i]] <- data
      cat("Added data from:", file, "\n")
    } else {
      cat("File missing required columns, skipping:", file, "\n")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ERROR processing file:", file, ":", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

#combine all successful results
combined_results <- do.call(rbind, all_data)

#count unique gene_id and cs_label pairs
gene_cs_pairs <- combined_results %>%
  select(OlinkID, CredibleSet) %>%
  distinct()

num_unique_pairs <- nrow(gene_cs_pairs)

#write the combined results to a file
write.table(combined_results, "~/multi_susie/cis_finemap_combined.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat("\nCombined results saved to:", combined_file_path, "\n")
cat("Total rows in combined results:", nrow(combined_results), "\n")
cat("Number of unique gene_id and cs_label pairs:", num_unique_pairs, "\n")
```
